replacements.new:
jobs:
  plan:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      plan: ${{ steps.selection.outputs.plan }}
      prepare_postgres: ${{ steps.selection.outputs.prepare_postgres }}
      contracts: ${{ steps.selection.outputs.contracts }}
      auth_integration: ${{ steps.selection.outputs.auth_integration }}
      browser: ${{ steps.selection.outputs.browser }}
      native_no_store: ${{ steps.selection.outputs.native_no_store }}
      native_no_store_fixed: ${{ steps.selection.outputs.native_no_store_fixed }}
      user_assets_fixed: ${{ steps.selection.outputs.user_assets_fixed }}
      browser_matrix: ${{ steps.selection.outputs.browser_matrix }}
      fixed_matrix: ${{ steps.selection.outputs.fixed_matrix }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '24.19.0'
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: web/package-lock.json
      - name: Install locked dependency parser
        run: npm ci --prefix web --cache /tmp/adtr-npm-cache
      - name: Verify selection and dependency parser contracts
        run: |
          python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts -p 'test_ci_selection_contract.py'
          node --test scripts/test_ci_dependencies.mjs
          python3 scripts/ci_selection.py --check-current
          python3 scripts/verify_requirements.py
      - name: Select immutable revision dependencies
        id: selection
        run: python3 scripts/ci_selection.py

replacements.new:
verify:
    if: ${{ always() }}
    needs: [plan, prepare-postgres, contracts, auth-integration, browser, native-no-store, native-no-store-fixed, user-assets-fixed]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4.4.0
        with:
          node-version: '24.19.0'
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: web/package-lock.json
      - name: Install the same locked dependency parser for independent verification
        run: npm ci --prefix web --cache /tmp/adtr-npm-cache
      - name: Recompute immutable dependencies and require every selected check
        env:
          SELECTION_PLAN: ${{ needs.plan.outputs.plan }}
          NEEDS_JSON: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: python3 scripts/ci_selection_summary.py
